title: Projective-line exceptional base change over arbitrary schemes
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $S$ an arbitrary scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose some positive integer kills $\Lambda$ and is a unit in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$. Write $q:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ for the projective-line projection [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], using the coordinate type $\operatorname{Option}(\operatorname{ULift}(\operatorname{Fin}(1)))$. For every cartesian square with lower-right arrow $q$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and compactifiable, quasi-compact left arrow $q^\prime$ [def-asd-compactifiable, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], the canonical exceptional base-change mate [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint, def-amb-etale-compact-support] is invertible on the entire ordinary unbounded small-etale derived categories of constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Neither base is assumed Noetherian.

proof.text: Choose a positive exponent N invertible on S. Use the existing arbitrary-base finite Kummer splitting, its trace base-change equation and both supported diagonal integrals.

Reindex the target coordinates and transport the projective-line presentation across the given pullback square. Properness is preserved by base change. The diagonal adjunction theorem supplies each explicit twisted-pullback right adjoint with its actual constructed counit.

The concrete counit base-change equality supplies the compatibility required by isIso_mateEquiv_app_of_counit. Cancel compact-support exchange with its inverse; the explicit twisted-pullback comparison is an isomorphism. Thus every component of the canonical exceptional mate is invertible, and hence the whole natural transformation is invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem projectiveLineExceptionalBaseChange
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [HasInvertibleExponent Λ S] ⦃S' P' : Scheme.{u}⦄
    {g : S' ⟶ S} {q' : P' ⟶ S'}
    {g' : P' ⟶ ℙ(Option (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)); S)}
    (sq : IsPullback g' q' (ℙ(Option (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)); S) ↘ S) g)
    [HasCompactification q'] [QuasiCompact q'] :
    IsIso (rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq)
